definitions.explanation: The state-run railway that operated Japan's main rail network until it was broken up and privatized into the JR companies in 1987. Short for {日本国有鉄道|にほんこくゆうてつどう}, and still used when speaking of the pre-1987 era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国鉄|こくてつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いていた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather worked for Japanese National Railways.

examples.japanese: {国鉄|こくてつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧{六十二年|ろくじゅうにねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{民営化|みんえいか}→民営化：17587_mineika⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese National Railways was privatized in 1987.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国鉄時代|こくてつじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開通|かいつう}→開通：04122_kaitsuu⟧し、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{区間|くかん}→区間：18759_kukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: This line opened in the JNR era and still runs almost the same route today.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {国鉄時代|こくてつじだい}: the JNR era — before the 1987 privatization
- {国鉄|こくてつ}⟦{民営化|みんえいか}→民営化：17587_mineika⟧: the privatization of JNR
- {旧国鉄|きゅうこくてつ}: the former JNR — used when the contrast with JR matters

CULTURAL NOTE:
The privatization split the network into the regional JR companies (JR{東日本|ひがしにほん}, JR{西日本|にしにほん}, and others), so anything after 1987 is JR, not {国鉄|こくてつ}. Older speakers still say {国鉄|こくてつ} out of habit, and the word carries a nostalgic, Shōwa-era flavor.
